event.text: The USB union said on Instagram that it will hold a 24-hour national strike of social-cooperative and social-enterprise workers in the health, care, education and job-placement sectors on Monday, November 16, with a Rome rally at 10am, demanding pay rises, the return of welfare services to public bodies and better working conditions. This is the union's own announcement.
